title: Mood Trend and Low-Streak Alert
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mood:entry
| timechart span=1d avg(mood_score) as mood
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(mood<3,1,0))) as low_streak reset_after="(mood>=3)"
| eval concern=if(low_streak>=5,1,0)
description: Trends your daily mood and gently flags a run of consecutive low days worth paying attention to.
value: A sustained low streak is easy to miss day to day; surfacing it can be the nudge to reach out or seek support.
implementation: Ingest mood ratings into `index=personal`; alert on an extended run of low days.
visualization: Line chart of daily mood with low-streak highlighting.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks your daily mood and gently flags a run of low days, which can be a sign to reach out for support.
